files.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE full-body static key-pose drawing for a 2D cut-paper game, for pose review BEFORE animating.
Image 1 is the MASTER CHARACTER / STYLE / BUCKET reference: Elian carrying the bucket. Preserve exactly this young boy's face, tousled dark brown hair, child proportions, outfit, silver eight-point star, cream sleeves, belt, tan trousers, brown cuffed boots, and this same bucket's dimensions and design. It is a reference for identity and scale, NOT a target pose to retain. Image 2 is only the bucket design reference (bottom right); ignore all other props.
New pose: a genuine low SQUAT AT PICKUP. Full body in three-quarter view facing screen right, hips lowered and sitting back, both knees visibly bent roughly 90 degrees, thighs angled towards horizontal, both boots planted on the same ground plane with stable heel contact. Child proportions and continuous thighs-knees-shins-ankles, no detached legs. The back is naturally straight and the torso leans forward only enough to reach the handle; shoulders much lower than in standing. Elian looks down towards the wooden grip. The full bucket is sitting flat on the floor just ahead of and between the feet, offset slightly toward the viewer. His anatomical RIGHT hand (the hand carrying in Image 1, on viewer-left in that image) grasps the horizontal wooden handle grip from above. The grip passes through his curled fingers; opposing thumb correct. The bucket remains on the floor, no lifting yet. The other LEFT hand rests open on its own thigh above the knee for balance and must remain visible. Both arms grow continuously from their shoulders, elbows follow natural angles, wrists straight.
This must read immediately as squatting with the knees to pick up a heavy object, not an upright figure merely tilted, not a kneeling pose, not standing on tiptoes. Use the SAME bucket-to-body scale as Image 1.
Preserve the same crisp dark brown contours, ivory cut-paper border, simple warm shaded colors and cute face. One Elian, one bucket, two arms, two anatomically opposite hands, two legs, two boots. No duplicate fingers, no extra limbs, no clothing changes. Full figure and bucket with margin, plain warm off-white/light gray background matching Image 1, subtle sole contact shadows only. Portrait framing, no text, no scene, no animation arrows.

files.initial_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE full-body static key-pose drawing for a 2D cut-paper game, reviewed BEFORE animating.
Image 1 is the MASTER CHARACTER, style, proportions, costume and bucket reference. Preserve exactly this same boy Elian with tousled dark brown hair, large brown eyes, brown tunic trimmed with gold and a silver eight-point star, cream sleeves, belt, tan trousers and cuffed soft brown boots. Preserve the SAME bucket dimensions and design relative to his head/body. Image 2 is only the bottom-right bucket design reference; ignore the other props.
New pose: naturally LIFTING THE FULL BUCKET WITH BOTH HANDS, ready to pour but still upright. Full figure, three-quarter view facing screen right, stable hip-width stance, both soles planted with the far boot slightly behind, relaxed slightly flexed knees, torso balanced. Hold the bucket in front of the LOWER CHEST / upper abdomen and slightly toward screen right. The entire bucket and handle must remain WELL BELOW HIS CHIN, face fully unobstructed with a visible gap. Keep both shoulders relaxed and elbows BELOW SHOULDER HEIGHT and below the chin; no elbow or forearm beside or across the face.
The anatomical RIGHT hand (the carrying hand on viewer-left in Image 1) grips the wooden handle sleeve at its apex with naturally curled fingers and correctly opposing thumb. Its upper arm slopes DOWN from the shoulder to a low elbow outside the torso, and its forearm then slopes up naturally to the grip. The anatomical LEFT hand comes from the other shoulder and is OPEN, PALM UP, directly UNDER THE BUCKET BASE, taking its weight: four short fingers visibly curl just around the near bottom edge, thumb at the side. The underside rests in this cupped palm. This second hand MUST be a supporting open palm, NOT a closed fist stuck on the side of the bucket. Distinct anatomically opposite hands, straight connected wrists. The bucket remains upright and water level horizontal; no stream yet. He is visibly holding the weight with two arms and looking towards the bucket / intended pour direction.
Keep the original cute child proportions and simple rounded child hands, not realistic adult hands. Same simple warm painted shading, crisp dark brown outline and ivory cut-paper outer border as Image 1. Exactly two arms, two hands, two legs, two boots and ONE bucket. No broken limb angles, no disconnected wrists, no additional hand on the rim, no duplicate bodies. Plain warm off-white/light gray background matching Image 1, faint foot-contact shadow only. Full figure including boots and bucket inside generous margins. Portrait image, no labels, no scenery, no motion arrows.
files.final_edit_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, the two-handed bucket lifting pose. Image 2 is the master character/style reference only.
Correct ONE anatomical readability problem in Image 1: the supporting left hand under the bucket currently looks disconnected because its entire arm is hidden. Redraw the supporting LEFT arm so its cream sleeve, elbow, forearm and wrist are visibly and continuously connected from the far shoulder on viewer-right down around the OUTER RIGHT SIDE of the bucket to the open palm under its bottom. Leave enough visible cream sleeve OUTSIDE the bucket silhouette that the elbow and wrist can be followed clearly. Keep its elbow at waist height, below the shoulders, forearm angled naturally under the base, palm facing up and four short fingers curled around the near lower edge with a correct opposing thumb. No isolated floating hand and no arm emerging from the bucket. You may shift the bucket slightly toward the center of the abdomen and lower it a little if needed to expose the supporting arm naturally, adjusting the handle-gripping arm's contact to match.
Preserve exactly Elian's identity, head, hair, face, gaze, child proportions, standing stance, boots, costume, silver eight-point star, outline and painted style. Preserve the SAME wooden bucket and its size. Preserve the other RIGHT arm as a natural low-elbow grip on the wooden handle, fingers actually around the wooden grip. Both elbows remain below the face, face fully unobstructed, bucket below chin. Exactly two arms and two anatomically opposite hands. Keep the blank warm off-white background, full-body framing and foot shadow. No text, no diagram, no arrows. This is a static key pose, not a screenshot.

limits: Drawn pose proposals with a matte background, not Unity captures, prepared sprite layers or registered animation frames. Common scale and joint preparation follow visual acceptance.
